notes: Naming your export no longer redoes the edit. Typing "save it as slow motion.mp4" halved the speed, "export it as black and white.mp4" drained the colour, and "name it sharpened" started a long upscale — Crisp was reading the file name you chose as an instruction. Eight ways of naming an output were measured against six effect words and 37 of the 48 changed the footage; none of them do now. Asking for a format still works ("save it as mp4", "export as 1080p"), and an edit that comes with a name still runs the edit. Nothing got slower.
